def count_intersecting_wires(poles):
    n = len(poles)
    intersections = 0
    
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            for k in range(j + 1, n):
                for l in range(k + 1, n):
                    x1, y1 = poles[i]
                    x2, y2 = poles[j]
                    x3, y3 = poles[k]
                    x4, y4 = poles[l]
                    
                    # Check if four points form a convex quadrilateral or if any three points are collinear
                    def slope(p1, p2):
                        return float('inf') if p2[0] == p1[0] else (p2[1] - p1[1]) / (p2[0] - p1[0])
                    
                    s1 = slope(p1, p2)
                    s2 = slope(p3, p4)
                    s3 = slope(p1, p3)
                    s4 = slope(p2, p4)
                    
                    if (s1 != s2) and (s3 != s4):
                        intersections += 1
    
    return intersections

        return (p1[0] - p3[0]) * (p2[1] - p3[1]) != (p2[0] - p3[0]) * (p1[1] - p3[1])

        if is_intersecting(p1, p2, p3, p4):
            count += 1

from itertools import combinations

def count_intersecting_wires(poles):
    n = len(poles)
    intersections = 0
    
    # Check all pairs of poles
    for i, j in combinations(range(n), 2):
        for k, l in combinations(range(n), 2):
            if i != k and i != l and j != k and j != l:
                # Get the coordinates of the poles
                (x1, y1) = poles[i]
                (x2, y2) = poles[j]
                (x3, y3) = poles[k]
                (x4, y4) = poles[l]
                
                # Calculate the determinants
                det1 = x1 * y2 + x2 * y3 + x3 * y4 + x4 * y1 - y1 * x2 - y2 * x3 - y3 * x4 - y4 * x1
                det2 = x1 * y4 + x2 * y1 + x3 * y2 + x4 * y3 - y1 * x4 - y2 * x1 - y3 * x2 - y4 * x3
                
                # If determinants have opposite signs, wires intersect
                if (det1 > 0 and det2 < 0) or (det1 < 0 and det2 > 0):
                    intersections += 1
                    
    return intersections

from itertools import combinations

def count_intersections(points):
    def is_intersecting(p1, p2, q1, q2):
        return (p1[0] * (q1[1] - q2[1]) + p2[0] * (q2[1] - q1[1]) + q1[0] * (q2[1] - p2[1])) != \
               (p1[0] * (q1[1] - p2[1]) + p2[0] * (p2[1] - q1[1]) + q1[0] * (p2[1] - q1[1]))
    
    intersections = 0
    for p1, p2 in combinations(points, 2):
        for q1, q2 in combinations([point for point in points if point not in (p1, p2)], 2):
            if is_intersecting(p1, p2, q1, q2):
                intersections += 1
    return intersections
